Merge Risk: Low · up to e45c8
The change is mergeable with follow-up: screen-reader users must expand the widget to hear progress, acted-on copies retain their ready indicator, and the drag control does nothing when activated by keyboard.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to e45c8
The changes primarily affect how completed exports are presented. The new Library actions reuse existing local-file capabilities, destination labels do not initiate uploads, and export errors remain visible when progress is minimized. No introduced security issue was identified, although coverage is incomplete. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details
**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The new Library actions expose an existing capability for a matched local vault recording. The inspected path does not expand this into cross-tenant, cross-service, credential, or automatic-upload authority; equivalent reveal and drag actions were already available from the export completion card. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Ready-card file actions require a non-null local recording ID. Native drag rejects path separators and traversal markers and sanitizes the optional title into a display filename. Reveal continues through the existing vault-resolution contract; the new card does not supply arbitrary paths. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _inferred_ — Cancellation during finalization can leave a finalized recording without a ready notification, but that ordering predates this PR and does not reassign or delete the durable recording. The new card state remains separate from file cleanup and ownership.
